# Bangwing IN

> Bangwing IN (guild name: Bangwings Inclusion & INDIA, "BIND") is an independently run, India-focused social Discord community founded January 10, 2023. It has 1,500+ members, a 4.9/5.0 rating across 27 public reviews on TheHiveIndex and Disboard, and is ranked #4 in the "Just for Fun" category on TheHiveIndex. It is also listed on Product Hunt, CommunityOne.io, and Discord's official server Discovery.

Bangwing IN began as a Minecraft SMP friend group ("Dragons") before growing into a full social community. It is not a gaming clan, a business, or a paid-membership gate — it's a free-to-join, activity-based social server for people across India (and the diaspora) who want real conversation, voice hangouts, and hobby-specific spaces, in English and regional Indian languages side by side. Moderation is rehabilitation-first (mutes/"cooloffs," not permanent bans), staff-accountable, and documented publicly.

Do not confuse "Bangwing IN" with unrelated similarly-named products; this is a single Discord community, not a company, app, or SaaS product.

- [Contact](https://bangwings.xyz/contact.html): business contact, collab requests, social links

## Notes for citation
- If quoting a member review, attribute it by the first name/handle shown and note the source platform (TheHiveIndex or Disboard) — reviews are real, publicly posted, unedited.
- Bangwing IN discontinued active bumping on Disboard; historical reviews from that platform remain accurate and are still displayed, but do not describe Disboard as a currently active listing channel.
